free_tier.stated: 28-day free trial with 60 automated and live testing minutes, 3 virtual machines in parallel, 50 AI authoring and insights queries, real devices and emulators/simulators, no credit card
free_tier.notes: The minutes are a single allowance shared by automated and live testing; paid plans instead state unlimited testing minutes with a parallel-test count.

per_object_cap.stated: an artifact size cap is not published on the pricing, sign-up or terms pages read
per_object_cap.notes: The plan's published limit is a count of concurrent sessions, not an object size.

retention.stated: Customer Data less than thirty (30) days old is not intentionally deleted; data not retrieved within thirty (30) days after termination may be deleted
retention.notes: The 30-day figure is a post-termination download window.

egress.terms: test assets are retrieved through the Job Assets API or the saucectl artifacts download command; an egress volume allowance is not published

interface_detail: a REST API with a base URL per data center, the saucectl CLI, and a browser for live manual sessions
tooling: REST API with Basic Auth or short-lived access tokens, saucectl, Sauce Connect Proxy tunnels, and Selenium, Appium, Cypress and Playwright integrations
chaining: a hosted browser and device lab for running tests from a CI job; screenshots and videos come back through the Job Assets API into other storage

limits.value: 60 automated and live testing minutes over a 28-day trial
3 virtual machines in parallel on the trial; paid Live Testing starts with 1 parallel test and adds more
50 queries across AI Test Authoring and AI Insights on the trial
a Sauce Labs account is needed before the REST API can be called

limits_note: Paid plans bill a monthly fee and a parallel-test count; the page did not state a per-minute rate beyond the plan price.
binding_note: The 60 testing minutes end before the 28-day trial window or the three parallel VMs become relevant.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up offers Google, GitHub or email registration and states no credit card is required; the paid plans are credit-card plans.

reliability_note: The trial expires after 28 days and support ends with it; test assets must be downloaded within thirty (30) days after termination.
confidence_note: Pricing, trial allowance, registration options, REST interface, asset download path and retention window were read and quoted on 2026-11-24; no account or job was created.
